capability.library_text: Retail, wealth-management and institutional clients use Fidelity Crypto and Fidelity Digital Assets custody and trading routes; interested plan sponsors can add a bounded Digital Assets Account to a workplace plan.
capability.boundary: Eligibility, product availability and the responsible Fidelity legal entity differ by account, customer type and jurisdiction; a recordkeeping relationship does not authorize Fidelity to add an investment to every employer plan.
